explanation: Jesus who has risen from the dead and is the foundation of Christian belief in eternal life.
The event where Jesus came back to life after his death, as well as the future resurrection of all people.
The state where the soul separates from the body as a result of sin, but which Christ has overcome through the resurrection.
Transgression against God's law that led to death and separation from God in humanity.
The concept of being tempted or led away from the path of righteousness, something Paul warns the Corinthians against.
The physical form of humans that will be raised to an imperishable and glorious life at the resurrection.
God's victory over death through Christ, which gives hope of eternal life for believers.
